forbids: any proportion, percentage or float in the requirement view — counts only
note: A percentage of this catalogue is a completeness figure for a list nobody claimed was complete: the twenty-two requirements are the NIST policy spine, not the organisation's obligations. It is also a coverage claim wearing a number, so it survives every word list no-coverage-claim.sh applies.

mutations.why: the figure emitted into the analysis, where a renderer or an agent reading stdout will find it. Carries no percent sign and no telltale name, so only the no-float rule catches it — which is why that rule is stated as a type invariant rather than a wording one.
defeats: no float appears anywhere in the analysis

mutations.why: the figure computed and never emitted. Nothing in any output changes, so the behavioural half is silent — and the function ships, ready for the first caller who wants a number for a slide.
defeats: no shipped .py defines or formats a proportion
